messages:
ben-recruiter: Quick flag - morning panels (all loops for week) some interviewers report they can't find the scorecard from the calendar invite. happened twice today.

sarah-peopleops: Example invite id? are these internal or external interviewers?

ben-recruiter: invite id inv-45b for candidate G-703. All internal but several use Outlook on Mac and see empty body.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook_delivery inv-45b status=202 accepted -> retry status=409 conflict mapping_exists

olga-hiringops: I pulled ATS event log: scorecard generated and attached, enrichment worker retried after a duplicate event from the batch scheduler. second attempt failed with mapping_exists leaving invite unmodified.

mike-intops: Short-term fix: I'll deploy a tiny enrichment fallback that appends a short scorecard link and bullets into the invite body when enrichment missing after 15s. Rolling now.

ben-recruiter: That would help. Also a few interviewers said their "certified interviewer" badge didn't show in the panel UI even after completing training yesterday.

tasha-trainer: We did run a bulk certification import for last week's cohort under the "cert_v1" namespace. Roster reads currently query "cert_v2" only. looks like a namespace mismatch.

olga-hiringops: I'll add a union query to roster service and backfill cert_v1 into cert_v2 for active interviewers. Also adding a small prod check to surface "invite missing scorecard" flags on recruiter dashboard.

mike-intops: Patch deployed. calendar_patch succeeded for inv-45b and body now includes https://ats.redwood/s/G-703/scorecard plus 3-line summary. Example patch: POST /calendar/patch {"invite_id":"inv-45b","body":"Scorecard: https://ats.redwood/s/G-703/scorecard\nNotes: 3 buckets, 30m loop, please add green/yellow/red"}

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded inv-45b at 1929876569

tasha-trainer: I'll run the cert namespace backfill tonight and DM affected folks. also proposing we show training timestamp + cert namespace in roster hover to avoid confusion.

ben-recruiter: Thanks team - sending a manual note to the panel and asking them to re-open the invite. please let me know when backfill is done so I can confirm badges.

sarah-peopleops: Capturing follow-ups: 1) dashboard flag for missing scorecards (P1), 2) roster union query + backfill, 3) idempotency guard on enrichment worker. Adding to sprint and will track in interview ops playbook. Great response everyone. :clap:
